# Khohar Muhamad Fatahurrohman

Personal website: https://khoharrohman.my.id/

Khohar is an Informatics Engineering student at Politeknik Negeri Malang and Director at PT Aigarn Akademi Artificial. The site contains web projects, fiction, education and activity records. No articles or legal study notes are currently published in this local version.
